2640: Commissioned by Protean eGov Technologies Ltd. and authored by CDPG at IIM Bangalore, the ‘State of DPI in India 2026’ report examines the evolution of India’s DPI ecosystem and assesses implementation across five sectors: financial services, healthcare, agriculture, commerce and education.
